Song.Plot: Introduces Queen Seraphina, the Queen of Carnage. It describes her rise to power, her throne forged in fury, and her reign over a kingdom born from the ashes of a fallen empire.

[Pre-Chorus] From the ashes of empire, her kingdom is born, With a voice like the thunder, she summons the storm. Her whispers are poison, her touch is a blade, In the dance of destruction, her legend is made.
[Chorus] Hail to the Queen of Carnage, ruler of night, In the land of the broken, she is the light. With her scepter of shadows and crown of despair, She reigns over ruin, in the dark, we declare.

[Outro] So rise, oh, Queen, oh Queen of Carnage, let your darkness reign, In the halls of forever, your power will remain. With your scepter of shadows, and crown of despair, Eternal and ruthless, in your dark lair.
